Won a triple threat over Sean Watts and Randall Crane at Storm Warning; still an active roster member through the promotion's own 26 June 2001 report.

Lost the NEO Heavyweight Championship to Messiah at Rebirth and won it back from him at Crimson Glory, retaining against Lord Archibald Dunscaith on 8 September and still champion on the promotion's own December roster.
